description: ACOS Agent OS ontology: the entity kinds and typed relations of an agentic creator company. Graph files are JSONL: one node or edge per line, ids prefixed with their kind (brand:acme, agent:general-cfo).

kinds.brand: A public door or product line with its own audience, identity file, and register.
kinds.register: A voice register (vocabulary, tone, forbidden words) a brand speaks in.
kinds.repo: A source repository. Brands own repos; agents and skills live in repos.
kinds.role: A responsibility: a General (ceo, cto, cmo, cfo, coo, cpo, caio, chro) or a specialist role.
kinds.agent: A compiled or hand-written subagent with a mandate, tools, memory scope, and evals.
kinds.skill: A procedure (SKILL.md) an agent can load: procedural memory.
kinds.kernel: Shared doctrine every compiled agent inherits.
kinds.module: A stackable role or domain module layered on the kernel.
kinds.soul: An identity file (SOUL-SPEC): who speaks, for what, with which invariants.
kinds.knowledge-source: A document, dataset, or URL an agent treats as authority, with an owner and review cadence.
kinds.memory-scope: Where an agent remembers: native agent memory (user, project, local) or a shared-memory tag scope.
kinds.loop: A recurring piece of work with trigger, cadence, owner, gate, and receipt.
kinds.eval: A set of cases and graders that decides whether an agent or skill is good enough.
kinds.human-gate: A decision only the human owner can make (money, publish, merge, deploy, secrets, delete).
